title: Circle details USDC revenue split, says $819 million went to partners and costs in H1 2026
reason: Detailed financial breakdown from a major stablecoin issuer provides important transparency on unit economics and revenue distribution.

sources.summary: Circle breaks down its USDC revenue: about $1.4 billion in H1 2026, $819 million to partners and transaction costs, $473 million reinvested.

title: Visa Direct moves USDC prefunding into commercial production with Inyo Global
reason: Commercial production launch of USDC prefunding by Visa is a concrete adoption milestone for stablecoin infrastructure.

sources.summary: Visa Direct has brought USDC prefunding into commercial production with Inyo Global as its first commercial enabler.
